_quoi: CE QUE LES SONDES QUALIFIANTES ONT RÉVÉLÉ. Mesuré : une déclaration qui QUALIFIE le module fait servir des phrases qu'une charge vide ne fait pas servir — 13 pour DORA, 3 pour NIS 2, aucune pour cinq autres routes, où la dette déclarée n'en était donc pas une.

texte.Ce pourcentage mesure une REPRISE DE PRE: This percentage measures a RE-USE OF EVIDENCE, not compliance. It says what share of the delegated regulation's articles finds an answer in a certified management system — it does not say that those articles are met, still less that the competent authority will accept it.
texte.L'analyse d'incidences sur les activités: The business impact analysis of Article #(#) of the regulation, and the recovery time and recovery point objectives that follow from it.
texte.Le rapport sur le réexamen du cadre, dan: The report on the review of the framework, in a searchable electronic format, intended for the competent authority. No Annex A control produces it.
texte.Le rattachement au cadre de gestion du r: The link to the ICT risk management framework of Article # of the regulation and its approval by the management body.
texte.Le rattachement au processus de gestion: The link to the incident management process of Article # of the regulation, and the Article # classification that decides on notification.
texte.L'identification comme entité essentiell: Identification as an essential or important entity, under the national provisions transposing Article # of the directive, is not declared.
texte.Le rattachement des projets de TIC à la: The link between ICT projects and the digital operational resilience strategy, and the report to the management body.
texte.Le cycle de vie complet des clés — génér: The full key lifecycle — generation, renewal, archiving, revocation, destruction — which the standard treats in a single control.
texte.Le niveau de TOLÉRANCE au risque lié aux: The ICT risk TOLERANCE level approved under Article #(#)(b) of the regulation.
texte.Les conditions d'activation et de désact: The conditions for activating and deactivating the plans, and how they relate to the notification of major incidents.
texte.Aucune des cinq catégories de l'article: None of the five categories of Article #(#) is declared: Articles # to # apply.
texte.La périodicité et les scénarios que le r: The frequency and the scenarios that the regulation imposes, which the standard leaves to the organisation.
texte.Les critères de déclenchement de la déte: The detection trigger criteria, aligned with the thresholds of delegated regulation (EU) #/#.
texte.Secteur de l'annexe I, au-delà des plafo: Annex I sector, above the medium-sized enterprise ceilings.
